# SpexSol

> SpexSol s. r. o. is a small software studio in Slovakia (Bojničky). It builds web and mobile products, automation, AI integrations and does code audits for clients in Slovakia and abroad. Engagements are monthly retainers or fixed-price projects. Site is in English (/en) and Slovak (/sk).

Contact: skalicky@spexsol.sk. Replies within one business day.
Company ID (IČO): 57004196. VAT ID (DIČ): 2122528089.

## Pages

- [Home](https://spexsol.sk/en): services, offer, FAQ, contact form
- [Products & partnerships](https://spexsol.sk/en/products): apps and websites built, past collaborations
- [Case studies](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies): concept case studies showing problem framing and solution design
  - [FieldFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/fieldflow): concept (not a delivered product) for turning photographed field service reports into structured, human-reviewed records with AI-assisted extraction. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
- [Contact](https://spexsol.sk/en/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://spexsol.sk/en/privacy-policy): covers website and SpexSol mobile apps
- [Terms of Use](https://spexsol.sk/en/terms-of-use)
